title: Unimpeachable
summary: UNIMPE'ACHABLE, adjective 1. That cannot be impeached; that cannot be accused; free from stain, guilt or fault; as an unimpeachable reputation. 2. That cannot be called in question; as an unimpeachabl

inlines.v: UNIMPE'ACHABLE, adjective 1. That cannot be impeached; that cannot be accused; free from stain, guilt or fault; as an unimpeachable reputation. 2. That cannot be called in question; as an unimpeachable claim or testimony.
